title: file source
description: Polls a directory and produces a message for every file. The body is the file content; the header file.name is the file's path relative to the directory. A consumed file is deleted or moved to the .done subdirectory.

path.title: Directory
path.description: Directory to poll, from the URI (file:<directory>)

fileName.title: File name
fileName.description: Only consume files with exactly this name

autoCreate.title: Auto create
autoCreate.description: Create the directory if it does not exist

recursive.title: Recursive
recursive.description: Also consume files in subdirectories (except those starting with a dot)

delete.title: Delete
delete.description: Delete a consumed file instead of moving it to .done
